Fit the distributional-GLM baseline (correct family, no random effects)

Source: R/baselines.R
fit_glmm_distributional.Rd

Mirrors the Python GLMMDist-Naive baseline: stats::glm with Poisson, Gamma(link = "log"), or Gaussian per the resolved objective. Tweedie is approximated with Gamma(log) because base R doesn't ship a Tweedie family; the statmod::tweedie family can be substituted by passing family_override.

Usage

fit_glmm_distributional(df, config, family_override = NULL)

Arguments

df

A panel.

config

A run_config() object.

family_override

Optional family object to use directly.

Value

A list with $model, $attribution_shares, $formula, $family.
